text:
Harper: Quick kudos to @Diego and @Mei for helping the partner onboarding call this morning. They jumped into the meeting, debugged the API key mismatch, and stayed to verify the sync. Huge help :tada: :sparkles:
Diego: thanks! Mei spotted the env var typo in the config panel. Was quicker than coffee this morning :coffee: :eyes:
Mei: lol team effort. Rory also dropped a clear checklist afterwards which made followups trivial.
Rory: added a 3-step note to the partner runbook: `verify key prefix`, `confirm webhook url`, `restart sync job` — small but saves time later.
Harper: tiny fun idea: PeopleOps, can we send a micro-kudos token and a real coffee to the pair? They earned it.
PeopleOps: Kudos issued: 2 tokens to Diego, 2 tokens to Mei. Sending e-voucher for one coffee each. :white_check_mark:
ops-bot: alert routed: partner-sync-warning. Acknowledged by Diego at 2025-11-04T09:12:05Z. :robot_face:
Diego: thanks everyone. Appreciate the quick teamwork. Also adding a sticker to the wall: "Partner heroes" :label:
Mei: vote poll: sticker :heart: or coffee :coffee:?
Harper: :coffee: from me. tiny treat, big morale.
Rory: :heart: for sticker — future interns must see these artifacts.
Diego: both are good. either works. thanks again team.
Harper: closing loop: official thanks and added a one-liner to monthly kudos doc: "Diego & Mei rescued partner onboarding with fast debugging and clear docs." :sparkles:
